headline: Frequent Rework of Path Helper Functions
diagnosis: The commit history indicates a recurring theme of reworking helper functions, particularly those related to path sanitization and caching. The frequent changes suggest that the current implementations are not meeting performance or usability expectations, leading to multiple fixes and enhancements.
plan: Conduct a code review focusing on the path-related helper functions to identify specific pain points or inefficiencies.
Gather feedback from the team regarding the recent changes and their impact on performance and usability.
Establish a set of clear requirements for the path helper functions to ensure they meet the necessary performance benchmarks and usability standards.
Implement a comprehensive testing strategy to validate the functionality and performance of the path helpers before further changes are made.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the team to reduce bus factor.
